primitives.name: Share-Core Wiring Protocol
primitives.verbatim_quote: # Share-Core Wiring Cards — K11 → props stack (Wave SC) **Deck data class: CROWN.** This file describes the share-core design (masterplan §3.2) and the covariate bus — both named CROWN in `docs/ops/FREE_WINDOW_BLITZ.md` §3b.
primitives.assumptions: All data flows through CROWN-class cards under strict validation protocols; no public or free-tier access allowed.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure occurs if any card enters live p without masterplan §6 validation.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI's hypothesis validation engine where each card corresponds to a probabilistic assertion over player-level features.
layer2.telemetry: Verification status of each card against embedded shape fidelity.

primitives.name: Cross-Family Verification Rule
primitives.verbatim_quote: | **Cross-family verification rule (same as Wave K):** the verifier is a different model family than the author; the verifier runs the card's Verify command, checks type fidelity against the embedded shapes, then works the ATTACK list — each attack decided by a computation, not by reading.
primitives.assumptions: Verification requires independent model families to prevent self-referential bias.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Verification fails if the verifier belongs to the same family as the card's author.

layer2.mapping: Derives from GSE's adversarial testing framework, enforcing computational integrity checks across distinct model architectures.
layer2.telemetry: Type mismatch between expected and actual shape signatures during verification.

primitives.name: Fail-Closed Missing Data Policy
primitives.verbatim_quote: - **Fail-closed on missing data.** Missing/NaN/contradictory input ⇒ typed refusal or `KernelError` — never a default, never an imputed value, never a silently dropped row that changes semantics.
primitives.assumptions: Data integrity must be preserved even under incomplete observations.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Any missing or invalid datum triggers a KernelError rather than silent correction.

layer2.mapping: Mirrors GSI’s robustness principle where missing data leads to explicit rejection instead of implicit handling.
layer2.telemetry: Number of refused samples due to missing/invalid entries.

It mandates that all cards undergo rigorous validation before entering the live inference path, enforced by masterplan §6 gates. Each card operates under a fail-closed policy when encountering missing or contradictory data, ensuring semantic consistency. Cross-family verification ensures independence between model authors and verifiers, preventing self-referential biases.
